<div class="msg"><small>Message</small><span>License has expired. Please renew your license to continue.</span></div>

## Why it happens

The licence's expiry date has passed. The system administrator can still sign in, view, delete and open the licence page, but nobody can create or change anything. The **License** page warns 30 days before expiry.

## Fix it

Ask your supplier for the renewed key and activate it on the **License** page.

## Check that it worked

The **License** page shows the new expiry date.
